item.title: HISTORICALLY YOURS
item.description: There are many important dates in the history of our nation. October 13, 1775, is one of them. It was on this day that the Continental Congress authorized the purchase and outfitting of two armed vessels to intercept British supply ships during the Revolutionary War.
